categories.main_business_segments: Shanghai Model Organisms Center, Inc. (SMOC) primarily operates in the research, development, production, and sales of genetically modified animal models and related technical services. Its main business includes customized animal models, standardized animal models, model breeding, pharmacological evaluation and phenotypic analysis, animal husbandry services, and other related biological technology services. The company serves both scientific research clients and industrial clients, including pharmaceutical companies and CROs.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages four core technologies: CRISPR/Cas gene editing system, ES cell targeting technology, gene expression regulation technology, and assisted reproductive technology. It has developed proprietary gene editing enhancement systems and advanced culture systems for embryonic stem cells. Production methods include transgenic model construction, gene knockout, knockin, point mutation, and conditional knockout models, supported by advanced breeding and phenotypic analysis platforms.
categories.primary_customers_markets: SMOC serves over 950 scientific research institutions and more than 720 industrial clients, including universities, research institutes, hospitals, pharmaceutical companies, and CROs. Its products and services support gene function research, drug discovery, pharmacological evaluation, and preclinical studies. Key markets include oncology, immunology, metabolic diseases, rare diseases, and cell and gene therapy development.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with multiple production and R&D bases in Shanghai, Guangdong, and Beijing. It also has a wholly-owned subsidiary in the United States (Texas) serving as a base for operations and biopharmaceutical incubation. The company actively expands its overseas market presence, especially in North America, Europe, Japan, France, and South Korea, with overseas business accounting for about 14% of revenue and growing rapidly.
categories.supply_chain_position: SMOC operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the life sciences supply chain, focusing on the development, production, and delivery of genetically modified animal models and related CRO services. It provides customized and standardized animal models, breeding services, and preclinical pharmacological evaluation, supporting upstream pharmaceutical R&D and downstream clinical research.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes innovation-driven growth, focusing on optimizing gene editing technologies to improve efficiency and reduce off-target effects. It aims to expand its proprietary model library, especially humanized models for precision medicine, rare diseases, and antibody drug discovery. SMOC is building a comprehensive service platform covering model construction, breeding, phenotypic analysis, pharmacological evaluation, and humanized antibody screening to support the evolving needs of targeted and personalized medicine.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through sales of genetically modified animal models (customized and standardized), breeding services, pharmacological evaluation and phenotypic analysis services, and animal husbandry services. The company recognizes revenue upon delivery and customer confirmation or after an objection period. It also earns income from government subsidies, investment returns, and financial products.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: SMOC is a leading domestic player in the genetically modified animal model industry in China, competing with companies like WuXi AppTec, Beijing Biocytogen, and other regional providers. International competitors include Jackson Laboratory, Charles River Laboratories, and Taconic Biosciences. SMOC holds a strong market position with a large proprietary model library and advanced gene editing capabilities, maintaining a competitive edge in customized and humanized models.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, SMOC reported revenues of approximately RMB 381 million, a 4.01% increase year-over-year, and achieved net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 6.5 million, turning profitable after previous losses. The company’s R&D investment accounted for nearly 20% of revenue. Operating cash flow improved significantly, and overseas revenue grew by about 32%. Total assets were around RMB 1.93 billion with a slight decrease compared to the previous year.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: SMOC differentiates itself through a vast and diverse proprietary library of over 13,000 standardized models and 940+ humanized gene-modified models, enabling precise simulation of human disease and drug targets. Its integrated one-stop service platform from gene editing to pharmacological evaluation and antibody screening provides comprehensive support for innovative drug development. The company emphasizes high-quality, stable supply, rapid delivery, and customized solutions tailored to client-specific research needs, supported by advanced facilities and a multidisciplinary expert team.
